name: The Westin Edina Galleria
insider_take: Tucked inside one of Minnesota's most celebrated upscale shopping destinations, The Westin Edina Galleria blends retail therapy with genuine luxury — a rare pairing that makes this hotel feel like a world unto itself.
whats_special: Shop Without Leaving the Building: The hotel is directly connected to the Galleria Edina, home to over 50 luxury boutiques including Pottery Barn, Anthropologie, and local Minnesota favorites — a true shop-and-sleep concept. Westin's Signature Heavenly Bed®: Guests rave about the legendary Heavenly Bed experience — the very sleep system Westin pioneered that changed hotel bedding industry-wide. Prime Minneapolis Suburb Location: Edina is consistently ranked among the wealthiest and most livable cities in Minnesota, offering a polished, walkable environment just minutes from downtown Minneapolis. Marriott Luminous Portfolio: As part of Marriott's Luminous collection, this property sits alongside distinctive upscale hotels that offer elevated experiences beyond the standard brand stay.
pro_tip: Book a room on the upper floors for sweeping views of the Edina skyline and surrounding suburbs. Then time your check-in to coincide with the Galleria's seasonal sales events — you'll be just an elevator ride away from serious deals on premium brands.
dont_miss: 50th & France District: Just a short stroll away, this charming neighborhood is packed with locally-owned restaurants, wine bars, and boutiques — the true heartbeat of Edina's social scene. Centennial Lakes Park: A stunning 100-acre urban park moments from the hotel, perfect for a peaceful morning walk, paddleboat rental, or summertime outdoor concerts. Local Dining Scene: Edina boasts a thriving culinary scene — don't leave without dining at one of the acclaimed farm-to-table restaurants nearby that showcase the best of Minnesota's seasonal ingredients.
pros: Connected to Galleria shopping center with upscale retail and dining
Signature Westin Heavenly Beds for premium comfort
Modern fitness center and spa wellness amenities
Prime Edina location with easy Twin Cities access
